title.narrative: Strengthening Science–Society Dialogue in the Maghreb to Promote a Culture of Science and Evidence-Based Decision-Making

description.narrative: The workplan is set in a context where strengthening trust and interaction between science and society is essential to address complex global challenges and support evidence-based decision-making. It aims to reinforce dialogue mechanisms between science and society to foster a culture of science and improve the use of scientific evidence in policy and public decision-making processes. Key activities include establishing and strengthening platforms for science–society dialogue, organizing engagement and outreach activities with diverse stakeholders, and developing tools and guidance to support effective science communication and public discourse. The workplan also supports mechanisms to enhance stakeholder participation and the uptake of scientific knowledge in decision-making. Deliverables include strengthened or newly established dialogue platforms, science communication tools and guidance materials, increased stakeholder engagement in science outreach, and improved integration of scientific evidence into policy processes.
